code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    marker = max(max(row) for row in grid)
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for r in range(h):
        positions = [c for c, value in enumerate(grid[r]) if value == marker]
        for left, right in zip(positions, positions[1:]):
            for c in range(left + 1, right):
                out[r][c] = 3
    for c in range(w):
        positions = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] == marker]
        for top, bottom in zip(positions, positions[1:]):
            for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
                out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
